end.ch9.body:
The box is open, the Hero is "8+ years old" and on the other side the print shop machines are already running.
In Chapter 10 the Proofreader prints the final edition.

art.bb.title: GRAND ADVENTURE DELUXE
art.bb.hidden: To open the box, pull the tab. Adults only.
n.i1: The back of the box. Close up it's... cardboard. A lot of cardboard.
n.i2: The Hero wants to go forward. But there's the recommended-age turnstile.
p.i1: and he's zero years old. we assembled him in chapter 3.
n.i3: Exactly. Rules are rules. Recommended age: 8+. I'm terribly sorry. Really.
n.empty1: Four-colour printed cardboard. The luxury of 1996.
n.empty2: Nothing there. Just the back of a back.
n.page_wrong: Not on this page. Receipts go on page 30.
n.tool1: The arrows won't help here. Cardboard doesn't resize.
n.typo_req: "Sytem". The system doesn't meet the requirements to spell "system".
n.typo_made: "Made in Itlay". Made in a place that doesn't exist. Like the game.
n.badge: The recommended-age badge. The number changes if the rule changes, obviously.
n.barcode: The barcode. It ends in 340: the pages of the manual. A classy touch.
n.shots: Screenshots of the game. They're... the title, the room and the ravine. We've been there.
n.bullets1: "Zero errors guaranteed!" The Proofreader wrote that. You can tell.
n.bullets2: "340 pages of manual!" We've read thirty. We're ahead of schedule.
n.sticker: L. 89.900. In 1996 that was a serious price. ...There's something written underneath.
n.passed: The Hero got through. The turnstile is still a bit shaken.
n.too_young: The turnstile won't budge: Hero's age, zero years. Recommended age, 8+.
n.pass1: The turnstile let him through. An "8+ year old" Hero, assembled last Tuesday.
n.peel1: The price sticker, kept among the receipts. Great idea, for a game that was never sold.
n.peel2: And underneath it said: "To open the box, pull the tab. Adults only."
n.open_again: The box is open. You can hear the printing presses.
n.tab_what: A tab that says PULL. It doesn't say what for. Maybe under the price sticker?
n.tab_adult: "Adults only". And the Hero is on the other side of the turnstile. What a shame.
n.x1: The box opens... and on the other side is the print shop. The machines are already running.
c.x1: Printing of the final edition: next chapter. No error will be spared.
n.x2: No errors? But we ARE errors. The bridge, the key, the Hero. Me, probably.
p.x1: then we have to get there before the machines. forward.
n.old1: The Hero is "8+ years old". And the recommended age is now... zero years. Suitable for newborns.
n.one: One year old. Still too young. He's growing fast, though.
n.rating_one: "Recommended age: 1". A game for people who have just learned to walk. Like the Hero.
h.age.1: The turnstile blocks the Hero because he's zero years old. His sheet is on page 28.
h.age.2: The recommended age, on page 29, is a loose word. So is the Hero's age.
h.age.3: Swap 8+ (page 29) with 0 YEARS (page 28), then tap the turnstile.
h.sticker.1: The price sticker covers something written underneath.
h.sticker.2: Things from the world can be taken into the manual. Receipts are kept on page 30.
h.sticker.3: Drag the price sticker onto page 30 of the manual.
h.tab.1: Under the sticker it said how to open the box: pull the tab.
h.tab.2: It's "adults only": you need the Hero, on the other side of the turnstile.
h.tab.3: With the Hero past the turnstile and the sticker removed, tap the PULL tab at the top right.
